behaviors.title: Actionable GitHub runs become versioned failure context
invariants: Only actionable conclusions produce a failure context.
The context preserves failure evidence, provenance, and unavailable data explicitly.
The stable context id is reproducible for the same normalized evidence.

scenarios.title: A failed run is normalized with failed jobs and provenance
scenarios.oracle: Fixture-backed collection returns schema v1 context with the failed job, bounded evidence, stable id, and source URLs.

scenarios.title: Unavailable logs remain an explicit uncertainty
scenarios.oracle: When the job log endpoint is unavailable, the context records unavailable status and a missing-data note without inventing log text.

behaviors.title: Failure context becomes a bounded, trust-aware Codex prompt
invariants: Prompt output is deterministic for the same context.
Common credentials are redacted and log or patch content is bounded.
Evidence is marked untrusted and the requested work does not authorize merge, push, or automatic edits.

scenarios.title: Secrets and oversized logs are removed or bounded
scenarios.oracle: Rendered Markdown contains no fixture token, stays within configured bounds, and includes the evidence trust boundary.

behaviors.title: The provider workflow emits a prompt artifact without executing the failed commit
invariants: The provider edge listens to completed workflow runs and filters actionable conclusions.
The prompt workflow does not check out or execute the failed pull-request head.
The output artifact contains both JSON and Markdown prompt files.

scenarios.title: The workflow template uses the safe provider boundary
scenarios.oracle: Static workflow checks find workflow_run, least-privilege read permissions plus artifact upload, and no checkout or pull_request_target usage.

behaviors.title: A user can explicitly hand a prompt to Codex in read-only mode
invariants: The default handoff only prints the prompt and command.
An explicit start uses Codex read-only sandbox mode and never bypasses approvals or sandboxing.
Artifact download selects the exact run-scoped artifact and extracts only the known prompt files.

scenarios.title: The default handoff is non-mutating
scenarios.oracle: The CLI prints the prompt and read-only command without starting Codex or changing the checkout.

scenarios.title: Artifact retrieval cannot write arbitrary archive entries
scenarios.oracle: The downloader chooses the exact run-named artifact, rejects unsafe archive paths, and writes only codex-ci-prompt.json and codex-ci-prompt.md.
